{{Top|leg}}
A '''hull-cutting ring''' was a traditional tool of both [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]]. When attached to the exterior of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], it could cut through the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of another ship, allowing the crew of the former ship access to the latter ship. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the portside [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was replaced with a hull-cutting ring, which was utilized during a [[mission to the Koornacht Cluster]]. After the ''Falcon'' landed on the side of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']], the hull-cutting ring cut through the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] hull and allowed the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] crew access.
